description: Start an Instagram DM automation. Fastest: template (from dm_automations_list templates, e.g. comment_link, freebie_email, follow_first, welcome, story_reply, story_mention, faq) turns on a ready-made one, its {link} filled with link_id's link, link, your published link page or your top link. Or write your own: trigger, keywords, steps (messages with up to 3 buttons each: a counted link, or next to send the next message; ask_email collects an email), require_follow, and for the comment trigger a public reply and post_id to listen on one post only. Fields passed override the template's. One you write goes live at once unless live is false. One from a template saves off until you've reviewed it: turn it on with live: true here, or with dm_automation_update live: true. A comment trigger also needs the comments permission; check it first with dm_automation_test.

account_id.description: Defaults to the workspace's only Instagram account

disclose.description: The first automated message in a thread ends with disclosure_text (default true)

disclosure_text.description: The line the first automated message ends with, up to 60 characters (default "Sent automatically.")

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

keywords.description: Words that start it, matched whole ignoring case and accents ("link" matches "LINK please", not "linked")

link.description: Any https address for the template's {link}

link_id.description: A link from links_list for the template's {link}

live.description: false: save it paused. true: turn it on now (a template saves off unless you pass true, so someone reads it first)

on_ads.description: Comment trigger: also fire on a comment on an ad made from the post (default true)

post_id.description: Comment trigger: only comments on this post (post_list); null or omitted for every post the account lists

reply.description: Comment trigger: the public reply under the comment; {name} becomes their username

reply_variants.description: Comment trigger: 2 to 5 other wordings of the public reply, so 3 to 6 in all take turns under the comments; {name} becomes their username. [] keeps the reply alone

ask_email.description: Waits for them to reply with an email, saves it on the contact, then sends the next message

next.description: true: sends the next message (the conversation waits for this tap)

url.description: https address it opens; taps are counted on the automation and the person

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: dm_automation_create
title: Add a DM automation
